attributes.name: Doge Pepe
attributes.description:
DOPE is a community-driven meme token on the Solana blockchain, launched via Pump.fun in October 2026. Its name and imagery combine two well-known internet memes, Doge and Pepe, and come from a widely shared Reddit story in which a user accidentally spent about $1,900 in AI API costs and ended up with a single Doge-Pepe image.

DOPE was launched through the OTC launcher platform. The token's creator fees are routed to the platform, which uses a portion of them to buy a basket of reward tokens and distribute them to DOPE holders automatically, with no claiming or staking required. DOPE has no transaction tax.

DOPE is not affiliated with Dogecoin, Pepe, or Anthropic. Project information is available at dopeonotc.lol.

attributes.name: Irys
attributes.description: Irys is a Layer 1 datachain that unifies onchain data storage and smart contract execution into a single network. Traditional smart contract chains handle financial transactions but lack native primitives for working with data at scale. Traditional datachains handle storage but lack integration with smart contracts. Irys serves both. Irys bridges this gap by unifying storage and execution, making data programmable through IrysVM, its native EVM execution layer. The network offers flexible storage options: users can choose between term storage (temporary, duration-based) or permanent storage (one-time payment for perpetual retention). Both operate at at-cost pricing, made possible by Irys's multi-revenue model that combines storage fees, execution fees, and programmable data transactions. This design allows Irys to remain competitive on price while maintaining economic sustainability. Irys achieves instant data retrieval and infinite horizontal scaling. As demand grows, the network expands capacity by adding validators who prove continuous maintenance of their assigned data partitions. The network's native token, $IRYS, is used for all storage and execution fees, as well as validator staking.

attributes.name: Giga Tenev
attributes.description:
Giga Tenev is a black and white GigaChad meme coin on the Robinhood Chain. He is the mascot the chain deserves: slicked hair, shoulders squared, and a jaw that enters the room three seconds before the rest of him. Chin permanently up, eyes fixed slightly above whatever you are worried about, Giga Tenev does not read charts. He has never read the chart. The chart is just a rumor that reaches him late.

Born from the simple truth that every chain eventually gets the face it needs, $CHADTENEV is pure meme culture with zero tax and zero pretense. There is no utility and he would like you to stop asking. What exists instead is a fast growing, highly engaged community united by a single philosophy: keep your chin up.

The project is deliberately simple. Strong branding, daily meme drops, an open banner policy, and a culture that rewards confidence over complexity. In a market full of promises, Giga Tenev offers something rarer: a face worth holding through anything.

attributes.name: Artificial Inu
attributes.description: Artificial Inu (AI) is an ERC-20 community token launched through LONG on Robinhood Chain. Its principal market pairs AI directly with Robinhood's tokenized NVDA Stock Token through an onchain liquidity pool rather than a conventional stablecoin quote. Creator-fee routing from trading activity directs NVDA-denominated fees to a community vault and AI-denominated fees to permanent burns or locked balances. AI is a volatile community token; it does not represent NVIDIA equity, confer shareholder rights, or provide holders with an automatic right to redeem assets from the vault.
